_comment: Ground truth for documents/trade_confirmation_003.pdf. Deliberate trap: mirrors the Day-2 bug's exact layout -- 'Quantity: 500 (1,102,311 lbs gross)' gives a bare number plus a decoy weight conversion, then the very next line, 'Unit: USD per metric ton', is the PRICE's unit but reads positionally like it modifies the quantity above it. delivery_location intentionally omitted: the doc gives 'CIF Antwerp' (Delivery Terms) and 'Port of Antwerp' (Discharge Port) -- same city, different strings, so which the model should emit isn't unambiguous. Scoring it would just reproduce the known Rotterdam/Rotterdam(ARA) scorer artifact from doc 001.
